english.title: Intentionally encourage / assist the commission of a summary offence
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) did an act, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACT..), which was capable of encouraging or assisting the commission of a summary offence, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OFFENCE..), intending to encourage or assist in its commission
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 44 and 58 of the Serious Crime Act 2007.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 44(2) of the Serious Crime Act 2007 provides that the person is not to be taken to have intended to encourage or assist the commission of an offence merely because such encouragement or assistance was a foreseeable consequence of his act.
(ii) See also section 47 of the Serious Crime Act 2007 re points to be considered in proving this offence.
(iii) Section 55 of the Serious Crime Act 2007 provides that the offence is triable in the same way as the anticipated offence.
(iv) Issues of extra-territoriality: see section 52 of the Act for details of jurisdiction; section 53 provides that no proceedings for an offence triable by reason of any provision of Schedule 4 may be instituted without the consent of the Attorney General (issues of extra-territoriality).
(v) See Section 54 of the Act for details relating to the institution of proceedings.
(vi) MoPI Group 2 has been allocated to ensure manual review. The MoPI group of the substantive offence applies.

other.penalty:
Summary: the penalty for this offence is that for which the offender would be liable on conviction of the anticipated or reference offence, see section 58(3).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
